## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install nokit_machine_learning in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure nokit_machine_learning package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to nokit_machine_learning
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/apstrand/nokit-machine-learning):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/apstrand/nokit-machine-learning.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/apstrand/nokit-machine-learning)

``` sh
$ conda install -c apstrand nokit_machine_learning
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nokit-machine-learning/)

``` sh
$ pip install nokit_machine_learning
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/apstrand/nokit-machine-learning)’s
[pages](https://apstrand.github.io/nokit-machine-learning/).
Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/apstrand/nokit-machine-learning) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/nokit-machine-learning/) respectively.
